'''Gula Sem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Employed by [[Basuda]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of the [[Contraband Resale Corporation]], he resided him with him on [[Carrick Station]] selling embargoed items to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
